text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Hafez al-Assad receives more cables condemning the Israeli crime of bombing a bus in Damascus that killed 11 people.
- After a successful surgical operation, President Assad to return to office in a few days.
- Under the president's patronage, outstanding workers honoured. Prime Minister Mahmoud Zu'bi: "Syria is committed to peace principles and ready to resume peace talks."
- Jordanians plan to disrupt Israeli trade fair.
- Arab Bar Federation support Syria's stands.
- Assistant Secretary-General of the ruling Baath party al-Ahmar and head of the Jordanian Islamic Action Front sign a working paper to confront Israeli policies.
- Israel spreads war tension in south Lebanon; a new Lebanese complaint to the Coordination Committee.
- Arab League says Israel's obstinacy threatens a disaster for the whole region.
- Cabinet discusses amendment of some laws on which the Real Estate Bank was established.
- Warnings of the dangers of the Israeli policy; Lebanese President Elias Hrawi says: "The Zionist plan to explode the region is very clear."
